verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost the same, and both share the same flaws. The shoe sits off-centre in the bottom-left of a huge empty peach circle, leaving a large dead area in the middle of the design. The subhead 'Every mixed case.' is squeezed into a 3-line ragged column beside the CTA, which breaks reading order and leaves no gap between the copy and the CTA. The legal line is shrunk to an illegible size and jammed under the button near the bottom edge. A is very slightly better because its '20% off' headline is a little larger and stands out more; B's smaller headline adds to the empty-middle imbalance.
